name: document-reader
description: Optional bundled plugin for reading DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, XLS, and PDF through one unified tool.
description_cn: 可选随包插件：通过统一工具读取 DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、XLS 和 PDF。
workflow: Enable this plugin when a task requires reading DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, XLS, or PDF files.
Call document_read with the workspace-relative document path.
For writing Office/PDF files, use run_python_code instead of expecting a document write tool.
